agent.title: ✦ Ask Mannon
agent.label: Your question
agent.placeholder: What's my price for SKU-450 at 100?
agent.greeting: Hello — I can look up your prices, build an order, or check where your last one got to.
agent.examples: Try: “what's my price for SKU-450 at 100?”, “reorder my usual”, or “what are my payment terms?”
agent.failed: I'm having trouble — try again in a moment.
agent.fallback: You can also use the quick order form, or browse the catalogue:
agent.rate_limited: That's a lot of questions at once. Give me a minute and try again.
agent.not_for_you: This is for approved wholesale accounts. If you've applied, we'll be in touch.
agent.taken_over: Someone from the team has joined this conversation — they'll reply here.
agent.cart_failed: I couldn't add those to your cart. Try again, or add them from the product pages.
agent.quote_filed: Sent to Mannon — you'll get an email. Your reference is %number%.
agent.greeting_named: Hello %name% — I can look up your prices, build an order, or check where your last one got to.
